jobs.title: Workforce Dimensions Transformation Senior Manager
jobs.salary: $180,200 - $355,100 base, plus possible discretionary annual incentive
jobs.jobDescription: Job Description - Workforce Dimensions Transformation Senior Manager, Deloitte, requisition 359862. Position summary: Deloitte's Human Capital practice is focused on helping organizations redesign work, workforce, and operating models as AI, automation, and digital transformation change how enterprises create value. Responsibilities include leading cross-functional teams that develop workforce and organization strategies; aligning human capability, machine capacity, and business goals; advising clients on workforce strategy, work design, operating model design, organization effectiveness, skills, workforce analytics, AI impacts, job architecture, compensation, and change; structuring complex client problems; developing scenarios and recommendations for senior leaders; guiding leadership alignment and sustainable behavior change; and contributing to business development, solution development, thought leadership, and mentoring. Qualifications include a bachelor's degree; 8+ years of relevant workforce strategy, work design, operating model, organization design, workforce analytics, skills, or change-management experience; 4+ years leading related projects and teams; 5+ years supporting business development and pursuit strategy; 2+ years supporting AI, automation, or digital transformation; at least 1 year advising on workforce or organization implications of AI; and ability to travel about 50%. Consulting, staff leadership, facilitation, project management, analytics, and executive communication experience are preferred. Published base range is $180,200 to $355,100, with potential discretionary annual incentive. Recruiting is scheduled to close September 26, 2026.
jobs.fitLane: Workforce Strategy / AI Transformation / Executive Advisory
jobs.summary: Strong alignment to workforce strategy, AI-enabled transformation, executive advisory, organization design, thought leadership, and enterprise consulting. Main tradeoffs are the 50% travel expectation and business-development depth.
